content.text: FYI, I’m writing about Upton for Sunday’s paper -- Buster wrote you guys were trying to trade him in the summer. If there’s any info you want me to know about it, let me know.
Just tried c██ling you. I will t██k to you later
OK, I will c██l you back. My phone is on the charger
C██l me back. I want to make sure how you quote me is accurate.  Thanks
One second I will send to you

I didn't quote you. I wrote... "And over the course of the summer -- which was largely a struggle for Upton -- the Tigers received inquiries on him from other teams, according to gener██ manager ██ Avila. But those inquiries, before the trade deadline while Upton was struggling, never took the form of serious negotiations, as the Tigers picked up their play before the Aug. 1 trade deadline and stood pat."
Yes. That is accurate. Thanks. I appreciate it.
